## Review checklist

- [ ] The diff is limited to the linked issue's scope.
- [ ] Verification results and skipped checks are recorded.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes; no credentials or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] All relevant CI checks pass before merge.
- [ ] The maintainer has reviewed the final change before merge.
